duration.value: instantaneous DESCRIPTION This spell grants the caster a brief moment of time in which to catch his breath and take measure of his situation. When the Time Mage uses this cantrip during a surprise round they are acting in they may use a full-round action or a standard and move action as if they had a full turn.
